arguments.text:
#!/bin/sh
# Small range helpers.
clamp_range() {
    value=$1
    low=$2
    high=$3
    if [ "$value" -lt "$low" ]; then
        value=$low
    elif [ "$value" -gt "$high" ]; then
        value=$high
    fi
    printf '%s\n' "$value"
}

#!/bin/sh
# Print a sum and two clamped values.
. ./lib/math.sh
. ./lib/util.sh
sum=$(add 2 3)
bounded=$(clamp_range 10 0 5)
floor=$(clamp -3 0 5)
printf '%s %s %s\n' "$sum" "$bounded" "$floor"
